mentions.name: Correctify
mentions.description: This AI graphic designer converts text into finished designs based on the chosen size, style, and branding. It is currently optimized for restaurant menus, with potential expansion to long-form materials like brochures and infographics.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building an AI graphic designer that takes you text and converts into a finished design based on your choosen size, style and branding.

Currently optimized for restaurant menus but maybe we should expand to other type of long-form materials like brochures and infographics.
